name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 9 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.5 days starting 2025-08-25, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
